item.title: Refiner Phillips 66 can process 250,000 bpd of Venezuelan crude, CEO says
item.description: Before sanctions were imposed on Venezuela in 2019, several large U.S. Gulf Coast refineries bought and processed up to 800,000 bpd of Venezuela's heavy oil, according to U.S. government data.

item.title: How AMECO is expanding heavy lift and marine services for power projects
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger speaks with Jim Swanson about AMECO’s Infrastructure and Marine group and its role in supporting power generation projects nationwide.

item.title: How TEAM Inc. delivers turnkey mechanical integrity solutions
item.description: John Buck, director of mechanical integrity at TEAM, Inc., explains how TEAM Inc. approaches mechanical integrity by combining inspection, engineering and repair services into a single turnkey solution.

item.title: How Deltak is capturing waste heat to power efficiency gains
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger speaks with Kenneth Schall about Deltak’s role in waste heat recovery and heat recovery solutions for power and refining applications.

item.title: How the Coastal Texas protection system is reshaping storm surge defense
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger sits down with Sally Bakko and Michel Bechtel to examine the Coastal Texas protection system, often known as the Ike Dike, and its role in reducing storm surge risk along the Texas Gulf Coast.

item.title: Mexican crude quality issues impact Gulf Coast refiners
item.description: Multiple oil refineries in Texas and Louisiana have raised concerns about the quality of crude oil from Pemex, Mexico's state oil company, with some facilities reporting Maya crude containing up to 6% water content.

item.title: A predictable, reliable approach to tube plugging in nuclear plants and refineries
item.description: Across nuclear facilities and refineries, maintenance teams face ongoing pressure to complete heat exchanger repairs rapidly, safely and with full confidence in long‑term performance.

item.title: The Shaw Group to double workforce in Livingston Parish to support growing demand
item.description: The workforce expansion will take place at The Shaw Group’s pipe fabrication and specialty services facility located at 30103 Sunland Drive in Walker, 25 miles east of Baton Rouge.

item.title: e-STORAGE and Sunraycer announce 503 MWh battery energy storage projects in Texas
item.description: Under the agreements, e-STORAGE will deliver its SolBank 3.0 battery energy storage system and provide 10 years of long-term services, supporting system reliability, performance optimization, and availability throughout the project lifecycle.

item.title: Cheniere submits application to build massive LNG plant in Texas
item.description: The proposed project will be an expansion of Cheniere's Corpus Christi plant, which at present has a capacity of 18 mtpa but could soon produce as much as 25 mtpa with the ongoing Stage 3 expansion expected to be completed by the end of 2026.
